title: MINIATURE 19TH CENTURY PORTRAI...
identification: Circular pastel/watercolour portrait miniature of a young woman, gilt slip, turned mahogany frame. Verso trade label reads 'Done by / H.T. COSTANTINI / ...' (the 'Doni' in the scan notes is probably 'Done'). This matches Charles Henry Theodore Costantini (1803/4-1860), convict-transported miniature and watercolour portraitist who worked mainly in Tasmania and whose works fetch thousands. Not Italian, as the scan notes guessed. The label may mean the portrait is by him, or is a later copy or framer's label, so attribution is the whole value question. The image looks too refined and Continental in style to be sure it is his; his known Tasmanian work is usually ink/watercolour/gouache with a naive hand and often signed.
chrome_hint: Invaluable signed in: artist 'Charles Henry Theodore Costantini' sold prices, read results for Lawsons Jan/Apr/Jul 2025, Leski Nov 2019 and Nov 2021, Colville Mar 2019; also eBay sold 'Costantini miniature'.
